attributes.probed_form:
All in src/game/ui/select.c::do_player_select. BASELINE FORM at each of the ten sites: `menu = page + moff + 712;` followed (immediately, or after a switch dispatch) by `if (*(s32*)(menu + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, active)) == 0) {`.
PROBE S1 (REVERTED — real 1185 -> 1387, fuzzy 96.6218 -> 96.5560, multiset 13t unchanged): all ten active tests respelled `if (*(s32*)(page + moff + (712 + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, active))) == 0) {`, the `menu = page + moff + 712;` assignment left exactly where it stood. The 820 fold APPEARED (`lwz r0,820(r3)`), proving the fold is source-reachable, but the assignment preceding the load forced TWO registers (`add r3,r27,r29` then `addi r28,r3,712`, with r3 live across the addi) and rotated r28/r29 function-wide.
PROBE S2 (REVERTED — real 1179, insns O1882 -> O1878, multiset 13t -> 35t, fuzzy 96.3241): ONE variable, load first. `s32 act;` added to the loop-body declaration block; at four sites `menu = page + moff + 712;` / `if (*(s32*)(menu + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, active)) == 0) {` became `menu = page + moff;` / `act = *(s32*)(menu + (712 + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, active)));` / `menu += 712;` / `if (act == 0) {`. The registers went EXACT at the site (`add r29,r27,r28` ; `lwz r0,820(r29)`) but the `addi r29,r29,712` VANISHED: MWCC read `menu += 712` as a self-update and folded 712 into every later use instead (`lwz r7,740(r29)` where the target has `lwz r7,28(r29)`; `addi r3,r29,712` where the target has `mr r3,r29`), costing four instructions and fifteen mr-vs-addi rows.
PROBE S3 (KEPT, commit 2082ae41d — real 1193, insns O1882 restored, multiset 13t, fuzzy 96.8737): S2 with a SECOND local. `u8* slot;` and `s32 act;` declared in the loop-body block after `u8* menu;`, and the four sites written `slot = page + moff;` / `act = *(s32*)(slot + (712 + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, active)));` / `menu = slot + 712;` / `if (act == 0) {`. `menu` is now a distinct value, so MWCC materialises it, and `slot` is dead at that point, so the two coalesce into one register.
PROBE S4 (KEPT — multiset 13t -> 11t, insns O1884, fuzzy 97.5135): the same trio applied to five more sites, four of which required SINKING the computation out of its hoisted position into the arm that uses it — into the `else` of `if (gControllerButtons & 4)`, into `case 0:` of two `sel_step` switches, into the post-switch `if (sel_step != 0)` block, and into `case 0:` of a `switch (t)`. In each the old `menu = page + moff + 712;` line ABOVE the dispatch was deleted.
PROBE S5 (PARTIALLY KEPT — see S6): the trio applied to case 14's write-file-progress arm (deleting its pre-switch `menu = page + moff + 712;`) AND, in the same edit, to BOTH copies of the `u8* base = *(u8**)(menu + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, items));` block, respelling them `*(u8**)(slot + (712 + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, items)))` with `slot = page + moff;` before the block and `menu = slot + 712;` after its declarations. Together: real 1297, insns O1886, multiset 9t, fuzzy 97.5517.
PROBE S6 (KEPT, commit 2082ae41d — real 1207, insns O1886, multiset 9t, fuzzy 97.6578): S5 with the SECOND `items` block reverted to `*(u8**)(menu + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, items))`, leaving the case-14 conversion standing. This is the committed state.
PROBE S7 (NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL — DISCARDED): the two remaining plain assignments (source lines 1330 and 1379, the sites with no `active` read) split into `slot = page + moff;` / `menu = slot + 712;`. Byte-identical on every number printed (real 1207, O1886, 9t, fuzzy 97.6578).
PROBE S8 (NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL — DISCARDED): the same two lines with the commutative operands swapped, `menu = moff + page + 712;`. Also byte-identical on every number.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: For (1), one build: move the single `menu = slot + 712;` statement in the case-14 default block below the three declarations and re-run `probe.py game/ui/select do_player_select --fuzzy`; if the addi does not move from 0x148c to 0x1494 in `fnasm.py game/ui/select do_player_select 0x1480:0x14a0 --diff`, statement position does not decide this slot and the word is allocator-owned. For (2), one build: apply the trio to the source-line-1465 `items` block ONLY (leaving case-14 as committed) and read fresh fuzzy against 97.6578. For (2) there is also a ZERO-BUILD screen first: `fnasm.py game/ui/select do_player_select 0x1588:0x15b0` already shows the target there emitting `addi r24,r3,24` THEN `add r24,r22,r24` — the addi-BEFORE-add order, i.e. the OPPOSITE of every site this record converted — so the prediction is that the trio is wrong there and the pair result was not a masking artefact.

hypothesis.statement: The remaining count OVERSHOOT of 1 (T1885/O1886) is one misplaced `addi` and the tenth `menu` site is still unconverted, and BOTH are addressable without a new mechanism. (1) At 0x148c ours emits `menu = slot + 712;` BEFORE the two `li` that initialise the loop counters, where the target emits it AFTER them (target 0x1494: add 0x1484, lwz 740 0x1488, li -1, li 0, addi 0x1494). The untried form is to move that one assignment down past the `s32 k = 0; s32 off = k; s32 found = -1;` declarations to just before the `for (;;)`, or into the `if (found >= 0)` arm that consumes it. (2) The tenth active test, at case 14's `else` inside the write-file-progress arm, was converted, but the SECOND `items` block (the one at the `setup_sel_menu(i, motion_state)` site around source line 1465, NOT the case-14 one) was converted and then REVERTED because the pair measured real 1297 / fuzzy 97.5517 against 1207 / 97.6578 for the case-14 conversion alone. That revert was measured as a PAIR, never in isolation: the second block has never been converted on its own. Convert it alone and re-measure before concluding the shape differs there.
